description: Core database connector services for source/user database resolution, migration, backup, reset, repository access, and FLR CIF import/export.

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.status
rpc_methods.description: Report the connector's state and the active database.

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.open
rpc_methods.description: Open the connector on a database (the configured one by default).

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.backup
rpc_methods.description: Back up the active user database.

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.reset_from_source
rpc_methods.description: Reset the user database from the curated source database.

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.repository
rpc_methods.description: Repository metadata, optionally with record counts.

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.import_file
rpc_methods.description: Import a structure file into the database.

rpc_methods.name: database_connector.export_sample
rpc_methods.description: Export a sample as an FLR CIF file.
